---
title: "OS non-proportional hazards — supporting analysis (5 imputations)"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This computationally reduced supporting analysis uses fixed imputations 1–5
and 200 standardized posterior survival draws per imputation.

```{r}
#| label: fit-supporting-os-nph
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- config$imputation$supporting$indices
imputation_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations.rds"
)
output_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-non-proportional-hazards"
)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
imputations <- readRDS(imputation_path)

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  draws_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!force && file.exists(model_path) && file.exists(draws_path)) next

  standardization_data <- mice::complete(imputations, index)
  standardization_data$mgps <- factor(
    standardization_data$mgps,
    levels = 0:2
  )
  # Match the primary OS likelihood: exclude the one intervention participant
  # censored on day zero from fitting, but retain them for standardization.
  fitting_data <- standardization_data |>
    dplyr::filter(survival_time_days > 0)
  model_formula <- survival::Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
    tve(tx, df = 3, degree = 2) + ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps
  model <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
    formula = model_formula,
    data = fitting_data,
    chains = 4L,
    iter = 1000L,
    warmup = 500L,
    cores = 4L,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index)
  )

  curve_list <- vector("list", 2L)
  # Reuse one seed so treatment and control select identical posterior draws.
  prediction_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index)
  for (treatment in 0:1) {
    newdata <- standardization_data
    newdata$tx <- treatment
    raw_curves <- rstanarm::posterior_survfit(
      model,
      newdata = newdata,
      times = 0,
      extrapolate = TRUE,
      standardise = TRUE,
      control = list(edist = 182, epoints = 200L),
      return_matrix = TRUE,
      draws = 200L,
      seed = prediction_seed
    )
    curve_matrix <- if (is.matrix(raw_curves)) raw_curves else
      do.call(cbind, raw_curves)
    curve_matrix <- as.matrix(curve_matrix)
    times <- if (is.list(raw_curves)) {
      vapply(raw_curves, function(curve) {
        curve_time <- attr(curve, "times")
        if (length(curve_time) != 1L || !is.finite(curve_time)) {
          stop("Each standardized survival curve must contain one time point.")
        }
        as.numeric(curve_time)
      }, numeric(1))
    } else {
      attr(raw_curves, "times")
    }
    if (is.null(times)) times <- seq(0, 182, length.out = ncol(curve_matrix))
    if (nrow(curve_matrix) < 200L && ncol(curve_matrix) == 200L) {
      curve_matrix <- t(curve_matrix)
    }
    if (length(times) != ncol(curve_matrix)) {
      stop("Survival-curve time points do not match the posterior matrix.")
    }
    curve_matrix <- curve_matrix[seq_len(200L), , drop = FALSE]
    curve_list[[treatment + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      draw = rep(seq_len(200L), each = length(times)),
      time = rep(times, times = 200L),
      survival = as.vector(t(curve_matrix)),
      tx = treatment,
      imputation = index,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  arrow::write_parquet(
    do.call(rbind, curve_list),
    draws_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
}
```
